senses.gloss: m. (נָזַק) one who does damage, destroys, wastes.
units: Yoma 80ᵇ, sq. כי יאכל פרט למ׳ ‘if he eats’ (Lev. XXII, 14) which excludes him who wastes (by eating excessively).—In gen. (ה) מ׳ the offender that occasioned damage, opp. ניזק the injured claimant.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:2">B. Kam. I, 2</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַזִּיקִים</he>, <he>מַזִּיקִיו</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:11">Ib. III, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00459"><he>נָזַק</he></cite>.—
Gen. R. s. 54 מַוִּיקֵי ביתו the annoyances of one’s house (flies &c.).—Esp. demons.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3a">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>מפני המ׳</he> on account of the demons (dwelling in ruins).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:3">Num. R. s. 12</cite>, beg.; a. fr.
